biography: Rob Barff, a name synonymous with both brilliance and bewildering inconsistency in the GT racing world, hails from a quiet village in the Cotswolds. His journey began not in a karting track, but tinkering with his father's vintage Triumph Spitfire. This early mechanical immersion ignited a passion for speed, leading him to scrape together funds for a season in Formula Ford. While lacking the raw pace of some contemporaries, Barff's technical understanding and relentless pursuit of perfection caught the eye of Competition Blue. His defining moment came at the Spa 24 Hours in 2018, where, against all odds, he wrestled a damaged car to a podium finish, showcasing grit and ingenuity. Now, at 36, Barff finds himself at what should be his peak, still with Competition Blue, battling to tame his inconsistent form and deliver the results his talent promises, always looking for that elusive championship title. He often recalls that wet race at Brands Hatch where he was leading and spun out on the last lap, costing him the championship; he says that moment haunts him to this day. Despite his setbacks, Barff is determined to prove his worth.
drivingStyle: Barff's driving style is a fascinating paradox. He possesses an uncanny ability to extract performance from the car through meticulous setup work and data analysis. He is known for his smooth inputs and tire management, often running longer stints than his rivals. However, under pressure, this calculated approach can crumble, leading to uncharacteristic errors and missed opportunities. He is a master of qualifying, often pulling out stunning lap times, but struggles to maintain that level of intensity throughout an entire race, especially when faced with aggressive overtaking maneuvers.

rivalries.name: Alessandro Rossi
rivalries.reason: A bitter rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at Monza in 2019, where Rossi accused Barff of deliberately blocking him, resulting in Rossi's retirement.

rivalries.name: Ingrid Muller
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle for position that has often spilled over into heated exchanges in the paddock. They respect each other's talent, but neither is willing to yield an inch.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka, a young hotshot, publicly dismissed Barff as 'past his prime,' fueling a competitive fire within the Brit to prove him wrong.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, regardless of weather.
Refuses to eat anything green the night before a race.
Spends at least 30 minutes visualizing the first lap of the race, obsessively replaying different scenarios.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about understanding the machine, the track, and, most importantly, yourself. The rest is just luck."
careerHighlight: Secured a remarkable podium finish at the 2018 Spa 24 Hours, single-handedly nursing a severely damaged car for the final six hours of the race after a teammate error.
careerLowPoint: Spinning out of the lead on the final lap of the 2017 British GT Championship finale at Brands Hatch, handing the title to a rival and shattering his team's hopes.
